paper_title: A complete theory of the Clifford commutant
authors: Lennart Bittel; Jens Eisert; Lorenzo Leone; Antonio A. Mele; Salvatore F.E. Oliviero
statement: Open Question 1. As noted above, invariance under Clifford operations alone is not sufficient for a quantity to qualify as a monotone. The generalized stabilizer purities defined in Definition 74 have not yet been proven to be monotones for magic-state resource theory. Specifically, the question of whether Ω-stabilizer purity for Ω not being a primitive Pauli monomial (hence corresponding to stabilizer entropies) is non-decreasing under stabilizer operations remains an open question. See also Ref. [74].
context: However, since the Pauli monomial described above is the product of two primitives, we know that m(Ω6,6 ) = 2 and, therefore, achieves a typical value, when averaged over Haar random states, of d−2 + O(d−3 ).
